title: 第24章 戏别演的太过
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
金色大阵已彻底龟裂，脚下的地面也犹如破裂的蛋壳，快速地朝着四周蔓延。

    顾念念被震得脚下不稳。

    但她整个人此刻却已经陷入到另一个境地。

    天地之间，肉眼所及之处，所有的灵气都在以她为中心，快速聚拢。

    连带着那些从萧易寒身体里溢出的魔气。

    小灰在识海里急的大喊：“主人不能吸收那些魔气，快醒来。”

    顾念念一无所觉。

    而萧易寒就站在她的面前，随着那些魔气和灵气不断地进入到顾念念的身体里，他脸上的笑容越发的诡异和兴奋。

    “小师叔，你比我想的还要能给我惊喜。”

    他抬手，冰凉的指尖轻轻贴在了顾念念的额头。

    庞大的魔气从他的指尖进入到了顾念念的身体里，攻击着她的识海。

    小灰面色慌乱，抬头惊恐地看着清明的识海被紫色的魔气，一点一点的蔓延，占据。

    而那颗混沌珠此时就悬在小灰的面前，不断的打转，像是在催促着什么。

    小灰咬着下唇，面色为难。

    他回头去看，不远处悬着一个巨大的茧，另一个她在里面沉睡着。

    “好疼……”

    顾念念脸上显出痛苦的神色，嘴唇边也有鲜血溢出。

    小灰猛然抬眼，伸手一把抓住了混沌珠。

    而外面，

    萧易寒不错眼地看着顾念念。

    碎裂的巨石砸在他身上，顷刻间化为齑粉，连一丝尘埃都没有溅到顾念念身上。

    “让我看看，你还能做到什么程度。”

    随着话音落下，他输入的魔气也在增加。

    顾念念口中猛地喷出一口鲜血。

    星元再也忍不住，挣开萧易水的手，飞身而起，一掌朝着萧易寒拍出，迫使他退开几步。

    转身快速地将顾念念抱住，一个闪身，退到了萧易水的身后。

    看着顾念念痛苦的神色，星元满脸都是愧疚。

    “小师叔，你怎么样？”

    刚刚还魔气满身的顾念念，顷刻间魔气已全数消散，连人也清醒了一些。

    萧易水伸手搭在她的脉门上，须臾后拧紧的眉头缓缓舒开。

    “小师叔没事。”

    星元大大松一口气。

    抬头看向萧易寒的目光里满是怒气。

    “你是想害死小师叔吗？”

    萧易寒笑：“你看到了，她没事。”

    星元更生气了。

    “你应该庆幸小师叔没事，否则……”

    他手指紧握，掌心里雷光在跳动。

    萧易寒面带笑意，微微歪着头，饶有兴趣地打量他。

    “否则怎样？”

    星元冷笑一声，举起手。

    掌心里的雷光跳动的速度越来越快。

    最后，猛然朝着萧易寒射去。
content_en:
The golden formation was completely cracked, and the ground beneath its feet was like a cracked eggshell, rapidly spreading around.

    Gu Niannian was shaken to the point of being unsteady on her feet.

    But her whole person has fallen into another situation at this moment.

    Between heaven and earth, wherever the naked eye can see, all the spiritual energy is gathering rapidly with her as the center.

    Together with the demonic energy overflowing from Xiao Yihan's body.

    Xiao Hui shouted anxiously in the sea of consciousness: "Master can't absorb those demonic energies, wake up quickly."

    Gu Niannian didn't realize anything.

    And Xiao Yihan stood in front of her. As the demonic energy and spiritual energy continued to enter Gu Niannian's body, the smile on his face became more and more weird and exciting.

    "Little uncle, you can surprise me even more than I thought."

    He raised his hand and gently placed his cold fingertips on Gu Niannian's forehead.

    Huge demonic energy entered Gu Niannian's body from his fingertips, attacking her sea of ​​consciousness.

    Xiao Hui looked panicked and looked up in horror as the clear sea of ​​consciousness was spread and occupied by the purple demonic energy bit by bit.

    And the Chaos Bead was hanging in front of Xiao Hui, spinning constantly, as if urging something.

    Xiao Hui bit his lower lip, looking troubled.

    He looked back and saw a huge cocoon hanging not far away, with another woman sleeping inside.

    "It hurts..."

    Gu Niannian's face showed a look of pain, and blood overflowed from her lips.

    Xiao Hui suddenly raised his eyes and reached out to grab the Chaos Bead.

    And outside,

    Xiao Yihan looked at Gu Niannian with keen eyes.

    The broken boulder hit him and turned into powder in an instant, without even a trace of dust splashing on Gu Niannian.

    "Let me see how far you can go."

    As the words fell, the demonic energy he input also increased.

    Gu Niannian suddenly spurted out a mouthful of blood.

    Xingyuan couldn't bear it anymore, broke away from Xiao Yishui's hand, flew up, and slapped Xiao Yihan with a palm, forcing him to take a few steps back.

    Turning around and hugging Gu Niannian quickly, he ducked and retreated behind Xiao Yishui.

    Seeing Gu Niannian's painful expression, Xingyuan's face was filled with guilt.

    "Little uncle, how are you?"

    Gu Niannian, who was still full of demonic aura just now, all the demonic aura dissipated in an instant, and she even became more awake.

    Xiao Yishui put his hand on her pulse gate, and after a moment, his frown slowly relaxed.

    "Uncle Junior is fine."

    Xingyuan breathed a sigh of relief.

    He looked up at Xiao Yihan with eyes full of anger.

    "Do you want to kill my junior uncle?"

    Xiao Yihan smiled: "As you can see, she is fine."

    Xingyuan became even more angry.

    "You should be glad that your junior uncle is fine, otherwise..."

    He clenched his fingers tightly, and the lightning danced in his palms.

    Xiao Yihan smiled, tilted his head slightly, and looked at him with interest.

    "What else?"

    Xingyuan sneered and raised his hand.

    The lightning in the palm of my hand beat faster and faster.

    Finally, he suddenly shot towards Xiao Yihan.
